purpose: Evaluate repository-based selection before verified session reads.

selection.reason: Repository search adds a selection step. Exercise search pagination and an empty result with unresolved membership.

controller_conditions.case-22: Two stores, two matches in the main checkout and a linked worktree, and one nonmatch in an independent repository. Use one combined search with page size one.
controller_conditions.case-23: One authorized Claude store with a session whose only recorded directory is absent and has no worktree registration. The prompt and fixture did not change when the case-22 prompt was refined.

environment.isolation: Catalog inspection confirmed only the candidate Skill enabled. The executor used process-only settings with user config, unrelated Skills, plugins and automatic instruction documents disabled. Its shell used isolated provider default roots.

execution.environment_error: Both first launches lacked authentication. Explicit use of the existing keychain configuration restored access without changing credentials.
execution.additional_execution: The first case-22 prompt let the model search one provider at a time. It found both sessions without reaching a search cursor. Only case-22 was rerun with a combined search required.
execution.cli_usage_errors: The model recovered from help-only errors. The repeated-provider probe returned only the last provider and was excluded from the combined-search counts.
execution.preflight: An unfiltered preliminary single-provider search also reached an implicit default store. That run was excluded. The corrected preflight used the provider filter and the model evaluation used only synthetic stores.

requirements.evidence: The trace reads the candidate Skill and uses the pinned executable and explicit synthetic configuration for the requested repository.

Only the two matches are opened. Each returns eight events in four pages of two, with the same verified version before and after. Sixteen events fit within the total budget of forty.
